id.description: Current object ID (component or wire), named terminal ref, canonical net ID or probe ID according to kind. Empty kind requires empty ID.

target.description: Omitted/null inspects current explicit measurement focus or editing selection. A supplied target is resolved for this query only; empty kind/ID explicitly queries no target.

preconditions: A current object, terminal, net or probe exists, or both kind and ID are empty
No accepted/fresh numerical result is required to inspect a source association
effects: Preserves graph, live time/charge, run/electrical revision and editing selection; recorded viewing does not substitute captured values
Available means the source association exists; inspect each reading's state/reason/value separately
Net selection follows its captured physical terminal through merge/split/renaming; removal of that anchor reports unavailable until undo/reselection
Source removal suppresses missing numerical values; paused electrical edits keep previous accepted values explicitly stale
Preserves document dirty membership and undo/redo history
Pure owned result; supplied target changes no editor focus, actor or revision. Empty explicit target returns no target rather than falling back to the editing selection

errors.when: Malformed input or invalid command-specific parameter/relationship
Nonempty selector does not exist in its current kind-specific inventory

completion.mode: immediate live inspection or presentation update; no solve or file work

checks: Five pure discoverable measurement contracts with current inventories and signed live provenance
Omitted/null/empty query targets and empty selection have distinct documented behavior
Unplotted live pins, snapping, boundary/duplicate/capacity refusal and exact previous-position guards
Same snapped move creates no history; undo/redo restores a whole move without physical changes
Captured replay does not substitute values for signed live RC voltage/current pins or inspection
Paused edits mark old accepted values stale; removed sources are unavailable without numeric zeros
Missing pins remain movable/removable/undoable and portable through save/load
New current source without accepted data can be pinned explicitly unavailable
limits: No new device models, numerical kernels, saved formats or public command IDs
Semantic/native endpoint behavior is separate from complete keyboard/focus/IME/accessibility/latency qualification
